# iOS Control Center for HyperOS **Turns the HyperOS Control Center into an iOS-style control center, with matching animations, modules and volume panel.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/iOS-Control-Center-HyperOS?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/iOS-Control-Center-HyperOS/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/iOS-Control-Center-HyperOS/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/iOS-Control-Center-HyperOS/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/iOS-Control-Center-HyperOS?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/iOS-Control-Center-HyperOS/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - iOS-style layout with connectivity, media and Smart Hub modules that expand in place - Jelly effect and reworked open/close animations, with a switch to keep the stock animation - iOS volume panel (can be turned off) - Glass blur on every container, with adjustable blur radius; backgrounds follow your theme - Media module in the iOS layout, showing the output device (AirPlay-style icon, Bluetooth device) - Tile groups, iOS-style icons and an edit mode: long-press any page to start editing - Reboot / power off actions that also work on Xiaomi.eu ROMs ### Tips - Long-press any page to enter edit mode without using the edit button. - Customisation → tap the author name 3 times at the very bottom for a hidden switch that hides the edit and power buttons. ## Requirements - HyperOS 3 or HyperOS 4 - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/iOS-Control-Center-HyperOS/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - Android 15+: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module. ## Screenshots

iOS Control Center for HyperOS

Turns the HyperOS Control Center into an iOS-style control center, with matching animations, modules and volume panel.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/iOS-Control-Center-HyperOS/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/iOS-Control-Center-HyperOS/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/iOS-Control-Center-HyperOS/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • iOS-style layout with connectivity, media and Smart Hub modules that expand in place
  • Jelly effect and reworked open/close animations, with a switch to keep the stock animation
  • iOS volume panel (can be turned off)
  • Glass blur on every container, with adjustable blur radius; backgrounds follow your theme
  • Media module in the iOS layout, showing the output device (AirPlay-style icon, Bluetooth device)
  • Tile groups, iOS-style icons and an edit mode: long-press any page to start editing
  • Reboot / power off actions that also work on Xiaomi.eu ROMs

    • Tips

  • Long-press any page to enter edit mode without using the edit button.
  • Customisation → tap the author name 3 times at the very bottom for a hidden switch that hides the edit and power buttons.

    • Requirements

  • HyperOS 3 or HyperOS 4
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/iOS-Control-Center-HyperOS/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • Android 15+: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module.
